players.name: Leighton Baines
players.note: Ever-present; 5 league goals and the league's most creative full-back. Peak season, elite set-piece delivery.

players.name: Sylvain Distin
players.note: Aged 34-35 but still quick and a dependable first-choice starter.

players.name: Séamus Coleman
players.note: Still sharing right-back with Neville and Hibbert; a year away from his breakout level.

players.name: Bryan Oviedo
players.note: 14 of 15 league appearances from the bench, deputising for Baines.

players.name: Marouane Fellaini
players.note: Played mostly in the hole behind the striker; 11 league goals, the club's top scorer.

players.name: Leon Osman
players.note: Earned his first England caps this season at 31.

players.name: Thomas Hitzlsperger
players.note: Injury-hit free signing well past his Stuttgart peak.

players.name: Ross Barkley
players.note: Aged 19 and a fringe player; spent much of the season on loan at Sheffield Wednesday and Leeds United, but Everton was his top-flight club. Rated as the player he was in 2012/13, not later.

players.name: Nikica Jelavić
players.note: Only 7 league goals in 37 appearances after a hot half-season in 2011/12; form fell away badly.

players.name: Steven Naismith
players.note: 18 of 31 league appearances as a substitute.

players.name: Apostolos Vellios
players.note: All six league appearances as a substitute; fringe squad forward.
